notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/plancomparisoncard.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/plancomparisoncard.md at e7ed622. The guide's Sources note and the evidence's Checked, Sources, Contract, Modes and tokens, Web render, Discrepancies and Hosting sections were checked on 21 October 2026 on 0.1.78-c7d3348 (Biscuit's main at c7d3348), so items citing them carry 2026-10-21 and 0.1.78-c7d3348. The evidence's dbe0e02 section (28 October) says Biscuit's ace46ca and dbe0e02 changed PlanComparisonCard for Component Bug #360 (still open: Component Fix › In progress, Biscuit), that the guide's copy was not re-checked on dbe0e02 and waits for #360's own publish, and that only the anatomy selectors were updated; its one observation of the installed build (the card is a role table with rows, column headers and cells) carries 2026-10-28 and 0.1.78-dbe0e02. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October); GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-c7d3348 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 modifies PlanComparisonCard's .tsx, .js and .d.ts. This entry follows the installed source, read, not run (token values through the package's own getVariableByName): header and body cells share one flex basis (label column flexGrow 1.8, plan columns 1, flexBasis 0, minWidth 0, padding inside each cell; PlanComparisonCard.tsx 122-134, 247-262), so plan names are centred over their columns; plan names are one line and end in an ellipsis (numberOfLines 1, line 424); feature labels and values have flexShrink 1 and minWidth 0 and no nowrap, so they wrap (205-235), and rows have a minimum height of 46 that grows when text wraps (250, 259, 336); the info icon sits in the label's text run (inline-flex); a static info icon is an image named infoLabel plus the row label (default “More information about”) and a false cell is an image named notIncludedLabel (default “Not included”), both new props (21-22, 285-298, 360-370); onInfoPress makes the icon a Pressable button with that name and hitSlop 8 (344-358); the root is role table, the plan names a row of column headers, the body a rowgroup of rows and cells (113-118, 317, 335-338, 379, 411-419); the row line sits inside every row but the last (391-405) and the table border is an inset outline on the web; the root is { gap 16, width 100% } with style after (411); string and number values are centred text, false a grey ic_close, null, undefined and true an empty cell, an element cloned with the card's modes (284-311); children replace the table and get the card's modes (442-444); the defaults are Your plan and JioFinance+ (brand) and four rows: JioPoints multiplier, Cashback 'Upto ₹5000', Bonus JioGold, Bonus JioSilver (102-112). Tokens: no mode but Color Mode changes any planComparisonCard token (Page type JioPlus, AppearanceBrand Secondary and Neutral, Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative and Emphasis Low change nothing; header 14/18 weight 500, white rgb(255,255,255) and gold rgb(206,161,90); table rgb(20,20,20), radius 16, 1 px rgb(30,26,20); cell padding 12, gap 2, min height 46; label 12/16 400; value 12/16 500; cross rgb(145,148,156); icons 16), so 'No mode restyles the card' holds. Left out because dbe0e02 contradicts them (reported for #360): Anatomy Feature's 'always on one line' (the part quotes only 'A row’s label, 12 px': labels wrap, and the info icon can drop onto a line of its own); Sizing's 'so at 328 px two plans leave about 67 px for each value and three plans about 48 px' (now about 62 and 44: 328 / 3.8 = 86.3 and 328 / 4.8 = 68.3 px per plan column, less 24 px of padding; only the 1.8-share clause is used); 'Text never wraps or shortens: a name, label, or value too long for its column runs into the next one.' (names end in …, labels and values wrap, nothing leaves the card); 'each row is 46 px' (a minimum: a wrapped label or value makes the row taller; #360's 27 October re-test measured row 2 at 56 with 'Upto ₹5000' at 328), so the Sizing items quote only 'Height follows the rows' and 'the plan names sit 16 px above the table'; the Sizing title 'Fills its host, nothing wraps'; States' 'and screen readers skip it' (the static icon is now a named image; only 'showInfo draws the icon as a hint: it doesn’t press' is used); the Do & Don't pair Short names for three plans / Long names in three columns, whose reason 'Text doesn’t wrap, so it runs into the next column and off the card.' no longer holds (its advice stays in Content: 'With three plans, keep names under about 8 characters.'); and the Sources note's 'the table’s cells don’t, because each cell’s padding counts first, so a name sits 3 to 8 px right of its column', 'Text never wraps or shortens and overflows narrow columns.', 'The table is 5 px taller than Figma’s because its row lines sit outside the 46 px cells' and 'The info icon from showInfo and the grey cross have no accessible name.'. Out of date in the evidence and not used: 'Five props' and 'No ... accessibilityLabel' (now seven props, with infoLabel and notIncludedLabel), showInfo's 'decorative, no role or name', 'All text has whiteSpace: nowrap and flexShrink: 0', 'No data-testid, no table roles', the Web render measurements (396 × 223, 47 px rows, cells about 1.62 : 1, 144 / 91 and 110 / 72 px cells at 328, the overflow figures), the Discrepancies on alignment, the 189 px table, wrapping, accessible names, table semantics and the fixed-English info name (infoLabel now sets it). Still failing on dbe0e02 and left to #360, not recorded as gaps (no evidence or guide quote supports the dbe0e02 numbers): at Figma's 328 px the default card is 228 tall with a 194 table against Figma's 218 / 184, because the sample 'Upto ₹5000' wraps after the 12 px cell padding (at 396 it is 218 / 184); the info icon follows the words but can drop onto a line of its own (three plans at 328: the Bonus JioGold row is 56.8). The row line under the third row is recorded as a gap from the evidence's Discrepancies (still true on dbe0e02: a line under every row but the last); it is in #360's re-test and is the Figma owner's call. Not recorded: Figma's planComparisonCard/header/gap (8), which dbe0e02 deliberately doesn't insert (its JSDoc says the gap would narrow each plan below Figma); the published Storybook's generated page and black host (not re-checked here); Color Mode, which changes three tokens (the evidence's Limits, and the building rules keep it off components); key on each row. avoidWhen is empty: the guide names no case for another component (the evidence quotes Biscuit's MDX pointing to HoldingsCard, CcCard and CompareTable, but the guide doesn't say it, as with HoldingsCard). Row and column fields are recorded as evidence facts (PlanComparisonColumn.label and .brand, PlanComparisonRow.label, .values, .showInfo and .onInfoPress) because the package facts expand only *Item[] row types; each still matches the installed type (PlanComparisonCard.tsx 27-36 and 53-70), and showInfo's fact leaves out the evidence's 'decorative, no role or name'. Anatomy: Plan names is always present (columns defaults to two sample plans); the table's parts are not, because children replace the table. The content rules that set columns and rows rest on the evidence's defaults, which the installed source keeps (102-112, 157-158). Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode and no modes at all. The guide's Page type JioPlus on every card is dropped (the evidence says it changes nothing on the card, and no example cell holds a component), as are the In context VStacks' Page type, Slot gap and Padding, its Texts' Text Sizes and Weight, and the Button's AppearanceBrand Primary (its default) and width style. No widths: the card fills its host (the guide's 328, 326 and 320 px widths fit its kit frames). The copy and values are the guide's own (TWO, ROWS, THREE and ROWS3 in the guide source; Get more with JioFinance+, Compare what you get today with the upgrade., Upgrade to JioFinance+); the handlers are stubs. Text, VStack and Button have entries. Left out of examples (three at most): the Badge cell, No recommendation, Without info icons, Custom body, the Hint and Button states, the Don'ts and the playground. Reported to the coordinator (host, not a guide sentence): every guide specimen sits in the kit's ScreenFrame surface="dark" and Storybook hosts the card on black, but the guide doesn't say the card needs a dark page. Its plan names are white (rgb(255,255,255)) with no panel behind them, and a Coin Screen is light (screen/body/background rgb(245,245,245), white under Page type JioPlus), so on a Screen the white names would not show; dropping the In context's Page type JioPlus also leaves its heading Text dark (text/foreground black). Sorting (batch 10, round 1): the cross-check found nothing to flag. Its notes say the accessibility items on infoLabel, notIncludedLabel and the table role describe dbe0e02 and disagree with the guide's Sources until #360 is published and the guide re-checked (as intended: they rest on package facts and the evidence's dbe0e02 section), and that the Three tiers example's gold Premium and its values can't be confirmed from the rendered copy; they are the guide source's THREE and ROWS3, so nothing changed. No dismissals.

examples.purpose: Upgrading from the user's plan, the guide's two-plan comparison: “Your plan” first, then the upgrade by its product name, gold as the recommended plan (brand). false marks what “Your plan” doesn't include, and showInfo adds hint icons to the features that need explaining.
examples.jsx:
<PlanComparisonCard
  columns={[{ label: 'Your plan' }, { label: 'JioFinance+', brand: true }]}
  rows={[
    { label: 'JioPoints multiplier', values: ['1x', '1.25x'] },
    { label: 'Cashback', showInfo: true, values: [false, '₹5,000'] },
    { label: 'Bonus JioGold', showInfo: true, values: [false, '1%'] },
  ]}
/>
